description: doctrine — shows each dispatched seat while it runs. In a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1) it panes the seat directly; in a contained agent (DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set) it only writes a request file to that mount for a host-side watcher, calling no herdr. With neither set it stands down, costing one process spawn per hook event and nothing else — and that is more than one per seat: Claude Code also fires SubagentStop for its own forked queries (a prompt suggestion after most turns, memory extraction), each with an empty agent_type, so a session that dispatches no seats still spawns roughly once per turn.
